newsitem.title: USA: U.S. power output rises 0.8 pct vs. year ago - EEI.
newsitem.headline: U.S. power output rises 0.8 pct vs. year ago - EEI.

text.p: Electricity deliveries in the continental U.S. totaled 62,096 gigawatt hours (GWh) for the week ended September 21, up 0.8 percent from the same period in 1995, the Edison Electric Institute (EEI) said.
The amount of power supplied to the South Central and New England areas rose the most, with some air conditioning demand from warm weather in the regions during the week.
EEI said the South Central region showed the biggest increase over the same week last year, rising 3.4 percent from 1995 to 9,299 MWh.
Year-to-date domestic power production totaled about 3.29 million GWh, up 2.8 percent from the same period in 1995, EEI said.
